description: This file provides a factory function to generate RESTful CRUD controllers for Mongoose models with built-in tenant scoping, filter sanitization, caching for list endpoints, error mapping, and customized query handling for specific model types.

methods.name: validateSort(sort, allowed = ['timestamp', 'created_at', '_id'])
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes the sort field from query parameters against an allowed list to prevent unindexed heavy sorts.

methods.name: clampLimit(limit, max = 500)
methods.description: Enforces a maximum limit for pagination to prevent heavy responses.

methods.name: microGet(key)
methods.description: Retrieves a cached list response if it exists and is not expired.

methods.name: microSet(key, payload)
methods.description: Stores a list response in the cache with TTL.

methods.name: buildListKey(req, filter, sort, page, limit, skip, explicit)
methods.description: Constructs a cache key for list API requests based on request parameters and query options.

methods.name: sanitizePayloadWithTenant(req)
methods.description: Cleans incoming payloads by removing client-controlled tenant identifiers and injecting tenantId from request context.

methods.name: mergeFilterWithTenant(filter, tenantId, forceOrgOnly = false)
methods.description: Merges and sanitizes the filter object with enforced tenant/organization constraints.

methods.name: buildCrudController(Model, listDefaultSort = '-timestamp')
methods.description: Main factory function that generates a set of CRUD operations for a given Mongoose model with tenant enforcement, filtering, sorting, caching, and error handling.
